title: Carrion crows can decide which way a cloud of dots was moving in about 235 milliseconds
summary_full: In a fascinating study from the University of Tübingen, researchers discovered that carrion crows possess a remarkable ability to determine the direction of moving dots far more swiftly than both humans and monkeys. Their decision-making occurs in a mere 235 milliseconds, with neural activity indicating decision processes before physical actions take place. This research enhances our understanding of the rapid cognitive capabilities present in various animal species.
